paper_title: Continuous Gradient-Energy Importance Accumulation Reduces Catastrophic Forgetting: an Empirical Audit of EWC's Fisher Snapshot Assumption
one_sentence_identity: We show that EWC's canonical hyperparameters systematically underfit activation heterogeneity in ResNet-18 architectures; continuous gradient-energy importance accumulation corrects this underfitting and reduces forgetting, with the effect attributable entirely to the importance weighting rather than thermodynamic regime detection.
do_not_submit_to_arxiv_until: Phase 2 HPC replication at n=20 is complete

contributions.contribution_1: Controlled EWC replication with corrected statistical methodology (t-distribution CIs, Bonferroni correction, power analysis) establishing that EWC with default hyperparameters systematically underperforms a plain SGD baseline on Split-CIFAR-10.
contributions.contribution_2: Continuous gradient-energy importance accumulation (ThermalImportance EMA) as an online approximation to the diagonal Fisher information matrix, with formal analysis showing EWC's snapshot estimator as the limiting case beta->1.
contributions.contribution_3: Pre-registered mechanism ablation: the elastic penalty is the sole productive component; the governor (regime-detection LR adjustment) never activates (rho=0, sigma=0) and governor-alone performs worse than SGD.

honest_limitations: The thermodynamic regime-detection LR adjustment (governor) DOES NOT contribute to performance. Phase 11 ablation shows governor-alone produces higher forgetting than plain SGD (0.250 vs 0.219). The governor never fires in any production trace (rho=0, sigma=0 in all runs examined).
rho=0, sigma=0 in all production traces — the learning-rate adjustment mechanism has never fired in production. The LR adjustment is dead code in all evaluated configurations.
Results are restricted to task-incremental learning (task IDs provided at test time). Results do not extend to class-incremental or domain-incremental protocols without further experimentation.
Single backbone (ResNet-18). Generalization to ViT, wider/deeper networks, or other architectures is untested.

The TCL vs EWC headline result (p=0.019, uncorrected) does NOT survive Bonferroni correction at k=4 (family-wise threshold p=0.0125). This comparison is directional evidence only and must not be stated as a confirmed significant finding.
DER++ and LwF are not included in the current comparison suite. Phase 2 replication scripts are written but GPU experiments have not yet run.
publication_allowed_results: phase11_ablation_full_vs_governor: p=0.0232, d=1.60, n=5, governor falsified as mechanism (5/5 seeds, governor-alone < SGD)
framing_constraints: Do NOT use 'thermodynamic' in technical claims. The word may appear only in: the TAR system acronym, historical framing of the original motivation, and the limitation statement that the thermodynamic mechanism does not contribute.
Do NOT claim Bonferroni significance for TCL vs EWC (p=0.019 > 0.0125).
Do NOT cite HPC autonomous variant as a confirmed result (paper_citation_allowed=false in inventory).
Do NOT claim the governor contributes to performance.
Every numerical result in the paper must be traceable to honest_evidence_inventory.json or raw comparison JSONs in tar_state/comparisons/.
